{{- $page := .page -}} {{- $class := or .class "episode-thumb" -}} {{- with $page.Params.thumbnail }} {{- $thumbParam := . -}} {{- /* Eerst proberen: thumbnail als Page Resource (bv. "thumbnail.png") */ -}} {{- $res := resources.Get $thumbParam -}} {{- if $res }} {{- /* Responsive WebP + JPG varianten */ -}} {{- $smallWebp := $res.Resize "320x webp" -}} {{- $mediumWebp := $res.Resize "640x webp" -}} {{- $largeWebp := $res.Resize "1024x webp" -}} {{- $smallJpg := $res.Resize "320x jpg" -}} {{- $mediumJpg := $res.Resize "640x jpg" -}} {{- $largeJpg := $res.Resize "1024x jpg" -}} {{- $alt := or $page.Params.thumbnail_alt (printf "Thumbnail van aflevering %s" $page.Title) -}} {{- else }} {{- /* Fallback: huidige situatie – gewoon het pad uit front matter gebruiken */ -}} {{- end }} {{- end }}
